postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati won the yardage fight, 510 to 440, and kept converting: 7-of-10 on third down, 5-of-6 in the red zone. Four turnovers nearly gave it away before Burrow ran one in to settle it 43-36 in OT.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 38/48, 462 yards, 5 TD, 3 INT, plus 3 carries for 10 yards and the OT rushing score. Volatile, but he carried it.
Tee Higgins: 10 catches, 155 yards, 2 TD. Ja'Marr Chase added 11 for 141 and a score after, per ESPN, spiking his helmet in frustration early.
Tennessee's Tony Pollard went for 21 carries, 117 yards, 2 TD against a Bengals front that gave up 5.6 a carry.
postgame.division_meaning: Pittsburgh stays ahead at 6-2 after hammering Cleveland 27-6. Cincinnati sits 5-2 on a three-game run with the best point differential in the North at +48. Cleveland 5-3, Baltimore 4-4 and sliding.
postgame.the_take: A 1-7 team hung 36 on you and the defence allowed 6.3 a play. Ben Baby's line about needing a complete game is right. Burrow's three picks against Atlanta's level of team is survivable, elsewhere it is not.
